title: The year in four things
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Thursday, the day after. The dog's year in four objects on the bedroom floor: the sock, the first leash, the rope sling from the derby scale, a maple bar's wrapper. Wood draws them in a row. The dog eats the wrapper during panel three. The strip allows it.

panels.composition: The floor: a sock, chewed. The first thing.

image.prompt: close on a chewed sock on a bedroom floor, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Beside it: the first leash, the vet's, and a loop of rope — the derby sling. Eleven pounds.

image.prompt: close on a worn leash and a loop of rope laid beside a sock on a floor, black and white, no words

panels.composition: A maple bar wrapper, flattened. BARNABY's nose entering the panel.

image.prompt: close on a flattened bakery wrapper on a floor with a small dog's nose entering the frame, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The row: sock, leash, rope, and a space where the wrapper was. The dog chewing. WOOD drawing the space. The year in three things and a dog.

image.prompt: a young man drawing a row of objects on a floor — a sock, a leash, a rope — with an empty space at the end and a small dog chewing something, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)

notes: Four things; the dog eats one. The year in three and a dog.
